name: readmission_risk
title: Readmission risk
outcome: Unplanned hospital readmission within 30 days of discharge
label: 30-day readmission risk

metrics.platform_parity: the platform's inputs reproduce Tiya's own exactly: all 63 labelled admissions score identically at 24 hours
metrics.cv_note: Tiya's grouped cross-validation: AUROC averages 0.42, below chance; the single held-out 0.97 rests on 3 readmissions

trained_on: The 63 MIMIC-IV-demo admissions in the shared training data that carry a readmission label (47 for training)
limitations: Ten readmissions in all, three in the test set, and in Tiya's cross-validation the AUROC averaged 0.42 (range 0.12 to 0.75): it does not yet rank patients reliably, and her own notes call it a research prototype. Runs only for patients with a hospital record (the MIMIC patients). Steps, active minutes and the activity change are carried forward from the last recorded snapshot because the platform receives no activity data. The high band is Tiya's exploratory alert threshold (0.329); the medium band (0.15) was set on the platform.
